recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-46177 unless HL7 later decides to republish older R4/R5 releases, which this Jira resolution explicitly said was not planned.
issue_request: FHIR-46177 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to add EDQM Standard Terms language codes to the Common Languages ValueSet with English and German descriptions; the accepted resolution declined R4/R5 republication and limited the source change to the R6 ValueSet.
initial_application: Git commit de9e82e87fe3248b8d20a96cd8cb58c898feeb35 initially applied the request by adding the listed language concepts to source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml. Later language-maintenance commits reorganized designations, but the requested concepts and translations remain present.
additional_context: source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml defines http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages as Common Languages. The ValueSet is part of the current build surface through the Language binding row using starter=valueset-languages and active StructureDefinition bindings. FHIR-46178 is the tightly related Common Languages typo/German-translation follow-up and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-49796 later rewrote the same ValueSet to add Hebrew designations while preserving the seed additions.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch was XML-checked for the 19 requested concepts bg, bs, cs, da, et, ga, hu, is, kk, lt, lv, mk, mt, ro, sk, sl, sq, tr, and uk, and each has the expected English display/designation and German designation.

related_jiras.note: Follow-up Common Languages issue for typos and German translations; already represented on the combined branch, so it was not duplicated here.
Later Hebrew/Common Languages maintenance rewrote the same ValueSet designation structure while preserving the FHIR-46177 language concepts.
